name: forge
description: Codebase-aware specification engine for Claude Code. Runs parallel codebase research, then a grounded interview that captures implicit facts as A-AUTO-NNN entries, emits typed Global Invariants / State Transitions / Contracts tables, runs an adversarial spec review at R3.5, then writes a foundry-ready spec with version frontmatter (v2.1) — locked, classified, citation-backed. Detects brownfield, greenfield, and cosmetic modes; brownfield runs produce a flow delta against the existing system. Forge plans. Foundry builds.

model.title: Agent model
model.description: Model for this plugin's config-steerable agents. Accepted values: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, inherit. Leave unset to change nothing — each agent's own model pin governs.
